plan.task: Scaffold Vite + TypeScript app with Vitest configuration
plan.notes: Scaffold in place: package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts (Vitest via vitest/config), index.html, src/main.ts, src/style.css, src/split.ts (toCents stub), src/split.test.ts, .gitignore. npm test and npm run build both pass.

plan.task: Implement pure split calculation in src/split.ts including even and weighted shares with deterministic cent-rounding
Add Vitest coverage for even split, weighted split, tax+tip, and exact-sum invariant
Build accessible responsive UI in index.html + src/main.ts with live share updates
Verify npm test and npm run build succeed
plan.notes: Will verify after scaffold and implementation exist.

decisions: The calculation logic must live in src/split.ts and the UI must consume that module.
Money is carried as integer cents in src/split.ts so shares can sum exactly to the total.
Vitest is configured inside vite.config.ts using defineConfig from 'vitest/config'; build script is 'tsc && vite build' so typecheck gates the build.
concerns: Need evidence that rounding is deterministic and that shares sum exactly to the computed total in cents.
Need verification that both npm test and npm run build pass without errors.
npm 11 blocks esbuild's postinstall by default; package.json carries an allowScripts entry for esbuild@0.28.2 so vite build works on a fresh install.
last_instruction: Initialize the repository as a Vite + TypeScript app with Vitest configured, creating the basic project skeleton needed for this brief (including package.json, Vite/TypeScript config, index.html, and src entry files). Do not implement the full splitter yet; just get the scaffold in place and then report the resulting branch diff plus the exact output of npm test and npm run build.
